title: MS-20 Late Filter DIY Builds (LM13700)
summary: Practical builds of René Schmitz's late MS-20 lowpass/highpass filter using an LM13700 OTA: Eurorack PCB versions, stripboard layouts and build logs covering calibration, the LED limiter in the resonance loop and part substitutions.
